The Actual Story

Editor's Note
04:00 AM

Two people studying. Somehow still finding little moments to talk in between. Even at four in the morning, talking to him could make the night feel lighter.

10th Grade

Two seats, holding hands, and a version of life I miss more than I expected. Those ordinary school days became some of my favourite memories.

Now

I miss the time we get to spend together — the random conversations, the nonsense, the little moments that never feel as little when they are with him.

Every meeting

That hug. The one that makes everything I was worrying about feel a little less important for a while. Like I can finally breathe and just be there with him.

Maybe that was the real story all along: not one huge moment, but a thousand tiny ones that slowly became everything.
